subject: Creativity
title: Design Thinking: Solving Problems Like a Designer
description: One-minute skill: Design Thinking: Solving Problems Like a Designer.

hook.text: Engineers solve with logic. Scientists solve with data. Designers solve with empathy.

buildup.text: Tim Brown of IDEO defined design thinking as a human-centered approach to innovation drawn from the designer's toolkit.

discovery.text: It's not about making things pretty. It's about understanding people deeply, then building solutions for their lives.

twist.text: Design thinking started in product design but now transforms healthcare, education, government, and social systems.

climax.text: Design-thinking companies outperform the S&P 500 by 228% over 10 years, per the Design Management Institute.

punchline.text: Design thinking isn't about design. It's about thinking differently.

quiz.question: Who defined design thinking as a human-centered approach to innovation?
